title: Looking Ahead to the Sharjah International Publishers Conference
excerpt: The 15th Sharjah Publishers Conference, held on 2–4 November 2025 and organised by the Sharjah Book Authority, brought together publishers and literary agencies from around the world.
image_alt: Audience in the main hall at the Publishers Conference in Sharjah, 2022
body:
The 15th Sharjah Publishers Conference, held on 2–4 November 2025 and organised by the Sharjah Book Authority, brought together publishers and literary agencies from around the world.

An opening day of discussions on key topics shaping the industry was followed by two days of B2B meetings, offering valuable opportunities to exchange ideas and explore collaborations. For Epsilon Publishing Group, the conference was a rewarding opportunity to introduce our authors and titles to international colleagues and strengthen our connections in the Middle East and beyond. We returned with new partnerships, fresh perspectives and inspiring ideas for the work ahead.
